name: Edgewood Tahoe Resort
positioning: Lodge-style resort on the shores of Lake Tahoe, bounded by the Sierra, with a lakeside golf course, Spa Edgewood and multi-bedroom Villa Suites
best_for: Golfers who want to play the lakeside course that hosts the American Century Championship
Families and groups who want two- to five-plus-bedroom Villa Suites
Spa-goers drawn to gemstone rituals and an Oxygen Bar designed for Tahoe's altitude

facts.text: Edgewood Tahoe Resort sits on the shores of Lake Tahoe, North America's largest alpine lake, bounded by the peaks of the Sierra.
The resort is inspired by the rustic elegance of the great lodges of the American West.
The Lodge at Edgewood Tahoe Resort opened in 2017.
The Edgewood property's history began about 150 years ago, when the Park family settled there as cattle ranchers.
The Lodge offers views of Lake Tahoe and the surrounding Sierra Nevada Mountains.
The lakeside Edgewood course has hosted national golf tournaments, including the annual American Century Championship.
The golf course is played at an altitude of more than 6,200 feet on the shores of Lake Tahoe.
The course hosted the 1980 USGA US Public Links Championship and the 1985 US Senior Open Championship.
Villa Suites come in two-, three-, four- and five-plus-bedroom layouts.
Villa Suite interiors feature European white oak floors, hand-tufted rugs and rich leathers.
Resort experiences range from yoga classes to nature walks to crafts and activities.
The Edge Restaurant & Lounge has a wine collection of more than 1,000 labels from around the world.

highlights.text: Each Villa Suite floor plan includes a heated private patio with a Jacuzzi and fire pit.
Spa Edgewood offers gemstone rituals that use locally sourced stones such as smoky quartz.
The spa has a signature Oxygen Bar designed for Tahoe's high altitude.
Tiger Woods, Arnold Palmer, Phil Mickelson, John Daly and Lee Trevino have all played the Edgewood course.
The Villa Suites sit next to the main lodge and front the 8th and 9th fairways.

considerations.text: The 2026 golf season ends on October 17, and the course reopens in May 2027.
An event venue expansion is underway from September 2025 to January 2027, with changes to valet parking at the adjacent Clubhouse building.
Spa Edgewood is an adult facility for guests 18 and older.
